piezas.titulo: Reading comprehension: Tone, politeness and implicit meaning
texto: Contextual reading of an essay on Thai cultural psychology and the concept of «เกรงใจ»: read the analysis of how intergenerational and hierarchical codes of respect shape evasive answers and eloquent silences. Notice how the author explains that a nod does not always mean agreement, but recognition of the human relationship.
